findings.location: source input/approval validation before protected-file check
findings.title: Require the readings and approval paths in the bound input map
findings.problem: The loader only requires a nonempty input map. If readings is absent from it and source approval working_readings_sha256 is null, .get(readings) and the approval value are both None, so the approval check passes and output is written without hashing the readings. This is a fail-open malformed-input case, not a problem with the current actual recipe.
findings.reproduction: Synthetic source approval {status:approved_source_only,working_readings_sha256:null}; recipe.readings points to readings.json but input_sha256 contains only the correct approval.json hash. main(--draft) returns0 and writes alpha.xml.
findings.requested_change: Require both recipe.readings and recipe.source_approval to be keys in input_sha256 before hashing. Add a CLI regression proving missing binding/null approval fails before any output write.
